reference_sql:
SELECT category,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE opened_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-11-16 00:00:00') AS nov_tickets,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE opened_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00') AS dec_tickets,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE opened_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00')
    - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE opened_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-11-16 00:00:00') AS change_tickets
FROM support_tickets
WHERE (opened_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND opened_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-11-16 00:00:00')
   OR (opened_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00' AND opened_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-16 00:00:00')
GROUP BY category
alternatives:
SELECT category,
  SUM(CASE WHEN opened_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-11-16 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nov_tickets,
  SUM(CASE WHEN opened_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dec_tickets,
  SUM(CASE WHEN opened_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS change_tickets
FROM support_tickets
WHERE CAST(opened_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2025-11-15'
   OR CAST(opened_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2025-12-15'
GROUP BY category

WITH counted AS (
  -- one row per category with a ticket in either period
  SELECT category,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(opened_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2025-11-15') AS nov_tickets,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(opened_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2025-12-15') AS dec_tickets
  FROM support_tickets
  WHERE CAST(opened_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2025-11-15'
     OR CAST(opened_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2025-12-15'
  GROUP BY category
)
SELECT category, nov_tickets, dec_tickets, dec_tickets - nov_tickets AS change_tickets
FROM counted

other_way.sql:
SELECT category,
  SUM(CASE WHEN opened_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-11-16 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nov_tickets,
  SUM(CASE WHEN opened_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dec_tickets,
  SUM(CASE WHEN opened_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS change_tickets
FROM support_tickets
WHERE CAST(opened_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2025-11-15'
   OR CAST(opened_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2025-12-15'
GROUP BY category
other_way.tradeoff: CASE with 1 and 0 counts the same way on engines without FILTER, but FILTER says which rows each count keeps more plainly.
